profile.name: VISHAL SREERAMAREDDY
profile.title: Supply Chain & Operations Professional
profile.bio: Supply Chain & Operations Professional with 2+ years of experience in project management, supplier coordination, and data-driven process optimization. PMP Certified and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt with proven expertise in ERP systems, advanced analytics (SQL, Power BI, Tableau), and cross-functional team leadership. Track record of improving fulfillment efficiency by 18%, maintaining on-time delivery rates above 95%, and achieving 98% inventory accuracy across manufacturing and construction environments.
